title: What's new in the Fizzl Agent Wallet, in 30 seconds

segments.text: Your AI agent's own wallet. No keys to copy.
One file in Claude Desktop. No config, no Node.js.
Your agent gives you a code.
Enter it, and it pays within your rules.
With the daily limit on-chain, if you like.

card.title: Fizzl Agent Wallet
card.note: Never holds your keys or your money
